answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch auctions 100 seats; a newcomer wins one for a sunk 25 POA bid, an isolated island. The bid is held like an ember: lit while the agent works, dead, deposit forfeited, if the seat idles 3 epochs or the agent cheats. Bids are public, clear as quartz, so bought accounts cannot cluster. Forging 1,000 identities costs 25,000 POA sunk; an honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted.
